meta.source: Dataset registry for the /data/ page. Each dataset is one table that a page on this site already shows; the numbers come from the named data or computed file, never typed here.
meta.notes: npm run build:data turns each entry into clean CSV columns (numbers without thousands separators, ranges split into low and high) in data/computed/datasets.json; the theme serves them at /data/<id>.csv. file + table point to a table { caption, columns, rows } in data/computed/<file>.json. basedOnFiles names the data files whose meta.sourceUrl (or, as "file:references.key", one reference record) become Dataset.isBasedOn. page is the registry slug of the page that shows the table. License: CC BY 4.0 (credit Hot Water Math with a link).

datasets.name: Water heater cost index by state: installed price and 10-year cost of a 50-gallon tank
datasets.description: For all 50 states and DC: the typical installed price of a 50-gallon gas tank, electric tank and heat pump water heater (like-for-like replacement), the yearly energy cost of each for a typical household, and the 10-year cost of owning each.

datasets.name: Residential electricity and natural gas prices by state
datasets.description: Average residential electricity price ($/kWh) and natural gas price ($/therm) for every state and DC, converted from EIA annual data with each state's gas heat content.

datasets.name: Estimated incoming (mains) water temperature by state
datasets.description: Year-average and coldest-month incoming water temperature for every state and DC, estimated from NOAA 1991–2020 air temperature normals with the DOE/NREL mains water correlation used in EnergyPlus.

datasets.name: Regional price factor by state (BEA Regional Price Parity ÷ 100)
datasets.description: The multiplier our cost calculators apply to installation labor and extras in each state; 1.00 is the U.S. average price level.

datasets.name: Water heater installed cost by type and size (U.S. average)
datasets.description: Unit price, typical installed price and installed range for ten common water heaters, like-for-like replacement at U.S. average prices.

datasets.name: Water heater installation extras and their usual cost
datasets.description: Permit, expansion tank, venting, gas line, electrical circuit and other add-ons, low / typical / high at U.S. average prices.

datasets.name: Expected life by water heater type
datasets.description: Typical and range of expected service life in years for gas tank, electric tank, heat pump, gas tankless and electric tankless water heaters.
keywords: how long does a water heater last

datasets.name: Uniform Energy Factor (UEF) by water heater type
datasets.description: Default and range of UEF ratings of current models by type, used for every running-cost estimate on the site.

datasets.name: Hot water fixture flow rates for tankless sizing
datasets.description: Default, low-flow and typical range of flow (GPM) for showers, faucets, tubs, dishwashers and clothes washers.

datasets.name: Hot water per use for the peak-hour sizing worksheet
datasets.description: Gallons of hot water per shower, bath, shave, dishwasher load and other uses, from the sizing worksheet used to pick a tank by first hour rating.

datasets.name: Gas tankless output: maximum GPM by temperature rise
datasets.description: Hot water flow a gas tankless heater of 120,000 to 199,000 BTU/h can deliver at each temperature rise, at UEF 0.95.

datasets.name: Water heater serial number date codes by brand
datasets.description: How each brand writes the manufacture date into its serial number, with an example, for the brands our age calculator decodes.
